title: Mindwalk: replays your Claude Code and Codex sessions as a 3D repo map

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Mindwalk replays clawed code and codec sessions as a 3D map of your repository instead of making you parse JSONL to understand what an agent did. After a risky change, you want to know where it explored, which files it ignored, and when editing began. Mindwalk lights each file by touch depth, flags churn and errors in a review strip, and lets you scrub context compactions, sub aent launches, and user turns.
